steps: The objectives of a computer network are to share resources, exchange data and information, and make communication between users easier and faster.
Resource sharing means that users connected to a network can use common hardware and software resources.
For example, several computers in an office can share one printer, and users can access files stored on a shared server.
Data communication means sending and receiving data between connected computers or devices.
For example, a user can send an email or transfer a file from one computer to another through a network.
Networks can also help reduce costs because resources such as printers and internet connections can be shared by many users.
items.finalAnswer: Computer networks make communication and data exchange easier and allow users to share resources such as printers, files, and internet connections.

steps: Star topology: All computers are connected to a central hub or switch. It is easy to manage, and failure of one computer usually does not affect the others; however, failure of the central device can stop the whole network. It requires more cable than a bus topology and is generally more costly.

Ring topology: Each computer is connected to two neighbouring computers, forming a closed ring. Data travels around the ring. A break in the ring or failure of a computer can disrupt communication, and adding or removing a computer can be difficult.

Bus topology: All computers are connected to one main cable called the backbone. It is simple and inexpensive and uses less cable than a star topology. However, failure of the backbone can stop the whole network, and performance may decrease when many computers are communicating.

Mesh topology: Computers are connected to many or all of the other computers. It is highly reliable because data can travel along alternative paths if a connection fails. However, it needs many connections and cables, making it costly and complex to install.

Comparison: Star and bus topologies are generally simpler to install than mesh. Star depends on its central device, bus depends on its backbone, and ring can be disrupted by a break in the ring. Mesh offers the greatest reliability but usually has the highest cost.
items.finalAnswer: Star uses a central device, ring forms a closed loop, bus uses a shared backbone, and mesh provides multiple paths; mesh is most reliable but costly, while star, ring, and bus each have characteristic points of failure.
